snippet.title: The Adventures Of Gael Longsword - Fantasy steampunk horror style open world RPG game - Teaser intro
snippet.description: This is the first teaser game intro of my forthcoming open world fantasy RPG game, available to wishlist soon on STEAM and to be released next spring after feedback from the playable demo. The game features many crazy sarcastic and hilarious characters played by real funny people, who are the main characters of the story lines o f this series of games ( this the first of many volumes of this epic adventures that will grow volume by volume). The game is based on the continent of Mercia and Grognorok, a fantasy steam punk world filled with dwarves, elves, goblins and many other dangerous creatures.  The game is set in a beautiful world , featuring platforming elements and some levels dark souls like with an atmospheric horror theme.  Gael, a middle age dwarf leaves his village to explore the world and search for treasure and unique adventure experiences.  The game, story and soundtrack original music by myself, Dragons Tears DJ. Subscribe to the channel to hear when the demo is ready to experience yourself.
